items.title: Bitcoin's 5-year return is nearly zero, great narratives are fading and what's left is the Fed
Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO as shares jump 27%
items.summary: Nasdaq futures rose nearly 7% and neocloud stocks gained as much as 16% after Nvidia’s board voted unanimously to reinstate Huang.

items.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
items.summary: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs above $63,000 as Nasdaq soars 6% on Huang return
items.summary: The Nvidia board announced the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as president, CEO, and director.

items.title: Bitcoin's losing streak is second-longest ever, and some observers see more downside
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 23, 2026

items.title: Ethereum wallets holding $72 billion ETH are under threat of a future quantum attack
items.summary: Researchers find that accounts with visible public keys hold nearly 55% of ether outside staking, and propose a way to move them to quantum-resistant security.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds from 2-year low as Wall Street futures recover
items.summary: Monday's market activity will show whether the weekend decline was seen as a dip and traders add to their holdings, or whether they abstain and the bounce fades.

items.title: Japan to ramp up crypto tax audits after uncovering $24.5 million in hidden income
items.summary: On-site audits of individual crypto traders averaged 12.58 million yen in extra tax per case, nearly triple the bureau's standard audit average.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin climbs back above $61,000 as stocks rebound from AI rout
items.summary: Bitcoin is recovering from a weekend plunge to nearly $55,500, its lowest in more than two years, as Nasdaq futures jumped 3% and Nvidia rallied.

items.title: South Korea to expand cryptocurrency account freezes and curb illicit transfers abroad
items.summary: The proposed measures would also expand a June phishing-account suspension system, which has already frozen more than 11,500 accounts, to cover other serious financial crimes.

items.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
items.summary: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
items.summary: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

items.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
items.summary: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.

items.title: How market depth shapes the price of a weekend Bitcoin sale
items.summary: Over 14 hours, Bitcoin traded on Kraken’s Canadian dollar market at an average 37.3% discount to a benchmark based on the exchange’s US dollar trades.

items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO amid ongoing intelligence probe
items.summary: Nvidia shares surged nearly 29% after the company’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following consultations with the US government.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: OKX, ICE launch 113 tokenized assets despite issuer objections
items.summary: The venture named Coinbase and Fidelity among the issuers and asset managers in the rollout after 67 companies objected to having their shares traded on the venue.

items.title: Trump-linked American Bitcoin secures $150M credit line from FalconX
items.summary: The miner can borrow against its Bitcoin to fund operations and expansion after selling about 465 BTC to cover expenses in the third quarter.

items.title: Strategy buys 457 Bitcoin, spends $212M on preferred share buybacks
items.summary: Strategy raised its preferred stock buyback limit to $4 billion and authorized the transfer of up to $1 billion from its dollar reserve.

items.title: AI agents are using credit cards. Where does that leave crypto?
items.summary: AI agents are already using credit cards to transact, raising questions about where crypto fits in the emerging agent economy.

items.title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Scores Again, Hitting $191,000 Jackpot Against the Odds
items.summary: The lone miner solved block 977057 through Solo CKPool, pocketing 3.13 BTC (worth about $191,000) in a lottery-like feat that normally only industrial-scale mining farms pull off.

items.title: Perps and Swaps: How to Trade the News on Decrypt
items.summary: Decrypt readers can now swap tokens and trade perpetual futures from a single Money Account. Here's how The Information Exchange works.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s Wealth Rises $36 Billion as Nvidia Surge Burns Short Sellers for $12 Billion
items.summary: Nvidia shares jumped more than 33% after the board reinstated Huang 11 days post-resignation, adding over $36 billion to his fortune while dealing short sellers their worst single-day loss since at least 2019.

items.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
items.summary: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.

items.title: Bitcoin Rallies, Anthropic Sinks as Nvidia Surges 35% on Jensen Huang’s Return
items.summary: Nvidia’s comeback sent chip shares soaring and gave Bitcoin a lift after a punishing selloff. Anthropic, fresh from its record IPO, missed the party.

items.title: Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO Days After Board Ruled Out His Return
items.summary: The board said senior U.S. officials' input left it confident Huang's return poses no national security risk. Shares jumped 26% premarket.

items.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Rebounds after NVDA Drives Friday Selloff
items.summary: The Nasdaq dropped 10% last week. Bitcoin lost 10% in a single day on Friday amidst cascading selloffs, though a relief rally is underway.

items.title: Strategy Buys $30M in Bitcoin, Moves $1B From USD Reserve to Cash Pot
items.summary: Michael Saylor's firm raised its preferred stock buyback program to $4 billion after repurchasing another $212 million of STRC last week.

items.title: Czech Authorities Charge 15 Over $12M Unlicensed Crypto Casino
items.summary: Investigators say "decentralized" casino BETFIN was run centrally, inflated its player numbers with bots and made $12 million illegally.

items.title: Solana Meme Coin for Fiona the Hippo Raises $100K for Cincinnati Zoo Charity
items.summary: A meme coin honoring the Cincinnati Zoo's late pygmy hippo has sent its creator rewards to the zoo's nonprofit.
